```yaml
name: E2E Portals

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  e2e-portals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      PORTAL_ID: ""

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Cache Cargo registry and git
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Build tavern
        run: cargo build --release -p tavern
        shell: bash

      - name: Build imixv2
        run: cargo build --release -p imixv2
        shell: bash

      - name: Build socks5 proxy
        run: cargo build --release -p socks5
        shell: bash

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: npm ci
        shell: bash

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq
        shell: bash

      - name: Start Tavern (redirect logs)
        run: |
          ./target/release/tavern > tavern.log 2>&1 &
          echo "TAVERN_PID=$!" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          sleep 5
        shell: bash

      - name: Start Imixv2
        run: |
          ./target/release/imixv2 &
          echo "IMIX_PID=$!" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          sleep 5
        shell: bash

      - name: Run Playwright portal test
        run: npx playwright test tests/e2e/tests/portal.spec.ts
        shell: bash

      - name: Retrieve Portal ID via GraphQL
        run: |
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"query":"{ portal { id } }"}' \
            http://localhost:8000/graphql)
          PORTAL_ID=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.data.portal.id')
          echo "PORTAL_ID=$PORTAL_ID" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        shell: bash

      - name: Start SOCKS5 proxy with Portal ID
        run: |
          ./target/release/socks5 --portal-id "$PORTAL_ID" &
          echo "SOCKS_PID=$!" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          sleep 5
        shell: bash

      - name: Start mock HTTP server
        run: |
          python3 -m http.server 8080 &
          echo "HTTP_PID=$!" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          sleep 5
        shell: bash

      - name: Verify data integrity through proxy
        run: |
          echo "This is a test file for checksum verification." > /tmp/test.txt
          ORIGINAL_CHECKSUM=$(sha256sum /tmp/test.txt | awk '{print $1}')
          curl --socks5-hostname localhost:1080 http://localhost:8080/test.txt -o /tmp/received.txt
          RECEIVED_CHECKSUM=$(sha256sum /tmp/received.txt | awk '{print $1}')
          if [ "$ORIGINAL_CHECKSUM" != "$RECEIVED_CHECKSUM" ]; then
            echo "Checksum mismatch: original=$ORIGINAL_CHECKSUM, received=$RECEIVED_CHECKSUM"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "Checksum verified successfully."
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Clean up background processes
        if: always()
        run: |
          kill -9 $TAVERN_PID || true
          kill -9 $IMIX_PID || true
          kill -9 $SOCKS_PID || true
          kill -9 $HTTP_PID || true
        shell: bash
```
